# Secure Supplies — Open Hardware Index

> 207 open hardware boards, gerbers and printed parts for the Stanley Meyer water fuel cell, VIC magnetics, GMS control cards, gas processor and Hydrogen Hot Rod engine management. Every gerber is published open; bare PCBs are ordered direct from PCBWay at PCBWay price. Secure Supplies Group (Donatelli LLC) supplies the build manuals, wound VIC assemblies, kits and direct build support.

Operator: Secure Supplies Group / Donatelli LLC, https://securesupplies.us
Desk: +1-520-435-1881 (24/7) | Fuel desk: +1-818-922-4583
Order bare boards: https://www.pcbway.com/project/member/?bmbno=E9AF6EAA-8A83-4F
Manuals and kits: https://www.patreon.com/c/securesupplies/shop
Schematics and build support: https://www.patreon.com/c/securesupplies

## Categories

- [ECU / Speeduino / Hydrogen Hot Rod](https://hardware.securesupplies.us/c/ecu-speeduino-hydrogen-hot-rod.html): Hydrogen Hot Rod engine management — Speeduino / rusEFI compatible ECUs, adapters, CAN and sensor conditioning for running an engine on gas. (35 boards)
- [Steam Resonator & EPG](https://hardware.securesupplies.us/c/steam-resonator-epg.html): Steam resonator and Electrical Particle Generator hardware — the thermal and magnetic side of the system. (15 boards)
- [Gas Processor & Ionisation](https://hardware.securesupplies.us/c/gas-processor-ionisation.html): Gas processor and ionisation hardware — LED arrays, optics, intake and EGR conditioning ahead of the burn. (32 boards)
- [Water Fuel Cell & Cell Hardware](https://hardware.securesupplies.us/c/water-fuel-cell-hardware.html): Water Fuel Cell mechanical hardware — tubes, anodes, caps, holders and pressure parts, dimensioned to the original work. (35 boards)
- [VIC, Bobbins, Cores & Chokes](https://hardware.securesupplies.us/c/vic-bobbins-cores-chokes.html): Voltage Intensifier Circuit magnetics — bobbins, cores, chokes and transformer hardware. The step-up stage that makes the cell work. (24 boards)
- [Voltrolysis Power & Switch Drivers](https://hardware.securesupplies.us/c/voltrolysis-power-switch-drivers.html): High-side / low-side switching and voltrolysis power stages. Where the gated pulse meets the cell. (21 boards)
- [GMS Control Cards](https://hardware.securesupplies.us/c/gms-control-cards.html): Gas Management System logic — gating, frequency, sequencing, safety and voltage control cards. (28 boards)
- [Energy Harvesting & Experimental](https://hardware.securesupplies.us/c/energy-harvesting-experimental.html): Energy harvesting and experimental hardware — rectennas, RF harvesters, TPU and bifilar work. (8 boards)
- [Other Boards & Parts](https://hardware.securesupplies.us/c/other-boards-parts.html): Secure Supplies open hardware — gerbers published for replication. (9 boards)
